Name: ROLLING_OBJ_LOT_PARAM_ST
Description: Random lots for rolling assets that spawn in the world (tumbleweed, glowing skulls and similar). The row is picked by map tile: mAA_BB_CC_00 uses row AABBCC00 (a map region can give its own lot instead). One asset is drawn by weight from the eight slots; the asset must have an AssetEnvironmentGeometryParam row.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it on 409 of 706 rows.
